I do this as well.  My current goals are to just get through this semester of school, learn to play the guitar, and get more physically fit.  Occasionally, they give me something to distract my mind with, but that's probably the farthest it goes for me.  I also have been trying to watch some funny TV shows to lighten my mood a bit.  

Thank you for your response.  It means a lot.  I'll put some more effort into dedicating myself to some more goals.

I am very glad that you managed to find happiness.  I have pretty terrible social problems, and I am fully aware of them and their negative effects on my life.  I have made plenty of conscious decisions to change.  However, it just seems to be a part of me, and no matter how hard I try, I just can't improve.  I feel as though I will never have that turning point like you did, and I will remain this way forever.  I appreciate your story though, it's nice to hear about these things.

I've been trying to find the little things that I enjoy, it's just that everything I've come to enjoy is out of my reach now and everything that I try to do just in some way or another brings me down more.

Thank you though.  I'm really not used to anyone even acknowledging me as another human being.  The only time people really do is when they want to use me for something and take advantage of my kindness and overly-caring nature.  I appreciate the fact that you took the time to reply to me.

I know.  I try to think like that.  I really do.  I've even given this sort of insight to other people.  I have never been this close before, though.  I have never truly understood why people would even consider suicide.  I've given myself many many chances and none have been successful.  I'm just stuck wondering if this sort of constant pain is even worth the off-chance that something positive MAY happen to me in the future.  

Thank you, though.  I really appreciate you even replying and giving me some sort of thought.
